intro: Here's how to add GoodCash to your app, from test keys to live keys.
form: First, get test keys. Enter your app name, your email, and the websites you'll test from.
testmail: We email you a link to confirm it's you. It works once.
testkeys: Save your test keys. They're shown one time only, and they never move real money.
build: Add the widget with two lines of code, then try full cash outs. No real money moves.
terminal: When you're ready, ask for live access, with one call from your server.
review: A person at GoodCash checks your setup against the go live checklist.
livemail: Once approved, we email you a one time link. It works for twenty four hours.
livekeys: Save your live keys. Your secret key stays on your server. Never in an app, or a chat.
switch: Swap test for live, then do one small, real cash out yourself first.
outro: Get your test keys today, at pay dot goodcash dot x y z.
